definitions.actual_losses: Lv=.5 mean(velocity normalized squared error), Ltheta=.5 mean(temperature normalized squared error), each averaged over ALL H intermediateoutputs. State covectors, not neural-parameter gradients. One held-out developedstate test100frame50 per backend; descriptive only.
definitions.physical_gradients: g_x=g_z/D is the physical-coordinate covector. Uniform cellvolume scalar would convert to Riesz density if divided by h²; no such extra factor applied here. Velocity complement includes unusedpadding, not wholly irrotational.
definitions.comparison: Own-residual S/F gradients combine changed maps and changed residuals/autonomous paths. The local matched-q control isolates derivative-map changes at x; C is evaluated at S(x).
definitions.heat: Mean temperature equals integratedheat for unitdomain. Absolute and initial-heat-relative drift given. Directphysical C preserves temperature bitwise; normalized/de-normalized wrapper may introduce roundoff.
definitions.rest: C-only constant-temperature/rest-state test, no claim that solver S was separately tested at rest. Centeringtemperature guaranteesoffsetinvariance but may leave learnedbias-induced velocity injection.
definitions.limits: No new training or gradient correctness gate. Native-stage conservation budget unavailable. KE can grow from buoyancy. Scalar variance and extrema changes descriptive. Existing mode-probe longhorizon FD ambiguities remain preserved in prior report.
